plugins.name: junkd
plugins.description: One plugin for handoff, orch, tldr, ctx-limit, ctx-tokens, the status line and the tools pane, plus the /junkd frame. /junkd:handoff saves a session handoff and /junkd:handon <id> resumes it; /junkd:ahandoff hands off automatically at a context threshold and resumes after the 5h rate limit. /junkd:orch runs the orchestration loop (/junkd:orch-init writes its .orch/config.md); the hooks module guards the main loop on Fable. /junkd:direction scores the code against the spec files the config names and lists the drift for a human decision. /junkd:lessons shows the pending orch lessons (local, repo and global stores) to promote, drop or move up; an orch run does not end while one is pending. /junkd:tldr N summarizes, /junkd:tldr on|off keeps every reply terse. /junkd:ctx-limit sets a context-size limit a prompt hook enforces (block, warn or a command); /junkd:ctx-tokens reads the live context usage. /junkd:statusline wires a colored status line (context, branch, worktree, model, effort, rate limits; each segment a setting) into settings.json. /junkd:tools opens the tools pane: this session's agents over the repo's git worktrees, and the tools, MCP servers and skills the session used. /junkd (and the ✚ junkd segment under the prompt) opens the junkd, handoff, orch, statusline, tools and lessons tabs together: the marketplace's plugins, every setting group (core, handoff, orch, tldr, ctx, statusline, tools) and the commands. The hooks module exports $.junkd for other mods.
